answer_1.quote: In this paper, we evaluate two key active perception abilities for MLLMs: 1) shifting, as real-world scenarios often present limited views and require shifts to obtain new perspectives, and 2) zooming, which helps enhance perception by zooming out for a broader view and zooming in for details.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate answers to visual questions and select relevant image views (zooming/shifts) as part of active perception evaluation.

answer_2.quote: We adopt accuracy as the evaluation metric for question answering, together with measurements of view selection (detailed in Appendix G).

answer_4.quote: We sampled 60 questions for human-level test, and recruit 6 testees, who did not participate in image collection and question annotation, to evaluate the human level performance of our benchmark.
answer_4.guideline: Testees answered questions either by themselves (Human) or with access to the Internet and LLMs for external knowledge (Human*), but were forbidden from directly searching for the answer. They also voted on the consistency of question-image-option-groundtruth quadruples.
